prior_scene_authority.policy: Reuse the existing cross-unit scene world and governed scene-family ontology; Q07 adds Unit04-local authoritative scene instances and does not create a second global canonical scene library.

prior_relation_scene_reuse.policy: Do not rematerialize sentence supply or duplicate canonical scenes for in/near/on/at. Unit04 may use only an already-admitted prior sentence together with its valid existing scene_ref; unresolved pairs fail closed downstream.

semantic_overlap_carry_forward.in_inside: A scene proving inside also normally supports in; downstream single-answer tasks must not force an unlicensed in/inside contrast.
semantic_overlap_carry_forward.near_overlay: Near may co-occur with behind, between, under or other relations; downstream options must avoid multiple-true answers.
semantic_overlap_carry_forward.next_to_near: Next to is YLE-safe support and may also satisfy near; it must not be contrasted with near as a unique single-answer choice without an explicit cue.
semantic_overlap_carry_forward.at_in: At and in remain viewpoint-sensitive and are not made mutually exclusive by Q07.
semantic_overlap_carry_forward.between: Both distinct reference landmarks must be visible and the located entity must occupy the interval between them.
